title: Color in use
slide_intent: Teach designers to recognize an identity across materials and viewing distances. The same hue can occupy an entire object, appear in clothing or pick out a word on a screen.
strategic_value: Bolt can connect an encounter with its transit advertising to an encounter with its dashboard. Blue recurs in each setting while the surrounding composition changes with the medium.
demonstration: Six tiles place lifestyle photography, a street advertisement, a phone, a tote, a dashboard and an illustration in one field. Blue appears as fabric, a bag ground, a navigation highlight and part of the dashboard headline.
practical_value: Compare a proposed product or campaign asset with the montage and choose which element should carry blue in that medium.

content_islands.name: Book rail
content_islands.spec: Retain the small white Bolt wordmark on a dark vertical strip and the folio at its foot.

content_islands.name: Lifestyle and tote
content_islands.spec: Stack a dining photograph above a close view of a blue tote on the left. Keep image edges aligned with a narrow gutter.

content_islands.name: Street and phone
content_islands.spec: Give the street advertisement the widest upper tile. Place the narrower phone photograph at upper right and retain the photographic surroundings in both images.

content_islands.name: Dashboard and illustration
content_islands.spec: Place the pale dashboard beneath the street scene, with its dark headline panel and blue emphasis. Fill the remaining lower-right tile with the illustration on a dark ground. Keep white gutters between the six tiles.
